[EN] Ah, are you a federation soldier? Just...can you just end this?"What happened to you?"
[ES] Ah, ¿eres un soldado de la federación? Solo... ¿puedes acabar con esto?"What happened to you?"

[EN] Everyone just...it was business as usual, and then everyone just starting losing their minds. I can't even explain it.

They killed...they killed everyone in our village. Please, get rid of them before they do worse. Target the {@linkcreature:19#4002#Lokain cleavers} and {@linkcreature:19#4001#Lokian rippers}. Bring me something tangible so I can be sure they're really gone.
[ES] Todos simplemente... era un día de negocios como cualquier otro, y de repente todos empezaron a perder la cabeza. Ni siquiera puedo explicarlo.

Mataron... mataron a todos en nuestra aldea. Por favor, deshazte de ellos antes de que hagan algo peor. Ve por los {@linkcreature:19#4002#Lokain cleavers} y los {@linkcreature:19#4001#Lokian rippers}. Tráeme algo tangible para poder estar seguro de que realmente se han ido.

[EN] Thank you. This...it brings me peace.

Please take this. It's all I have.
[ES] Gracias. Esto... me da paz.

Por favor, toma esto. Es todo lo tengo.

[EN] Please...I don't have much time, and I just...I need a moment of peace before I go.
[ES] Por favor... no tengo mucho tiempo, y solo... necesito un momento de paz antes de partir.
